Episode 28: Doppelganger
Keshav receives orders from his boss to invite Prema to an event. On the acting front, Prema is busy is another shoot. Prema’s lookalike is asked to arrive on the sets. Keshav reaches the sets at the same time and mistakes the duplicate to be Prema. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.
